caption: The drawing features two detailed line illustrations of a dress on a beige background. The main, larger illustration is centrally placed and depicts a full-length, high-waisted gown with a wide, rounded neckline and short puffed sleeves that are elaborately decorated with horizontal rows of ornament and lace trim. The bodice is softly gathered, and the waist is defined by a wide decorative band. The skirts are long and gently flare out, ending in an ornate scalloped hem with intricate floral embroidery or lacework. Near the upper right corner, there is a smaller version of the same dress, providing an alternate perspective that shows the front of the gown. Both figures lack heads, hands, and feet, focusing solely on the clothing, with the outlines and details rendered in grey against a light brown or cream background.
title: Dress
